title: NeuroMotionVector: brain-channel disagreement (D) vs longitudinal gait decline
role: Brain-imaging extension of HeartVector/BodyVector/MotionVector. NOT a replacement for the frozen CODE-15 confirmation. Tests the SAME prespecified shared-aging(A)/disagreement(D) geometry at a new biological scale.

governance.dua_key_clause: Re-distribution/transfer/sharing of Data OUTSIDE institution NOT permitted without prior written agreement; within-institution sharing requires each user be an approved registered BALSA user.
governance.posture: Participant-level AABC data is NOT redistributed. Only code, schema, checksums, simulated fixtures, group-level maps, and AGGREGATE results are shared. No participant ID is ever associated with data elements in any public output.
governance.execution_env: User-approved environment (Modal under UM affiliation, per data-owner decision 2026-07-12).

S_structure.features: 360 HCP-MMP v1.0 cortical thickness+volume ROIs + FreeSurfer subcortical volumes

M_myelin.features: 360 T1w/T2w areal myelin ROIs; global covariate correction REQUIRED before clock

F_function.package: RestFmriRecommended + VISMOTOR/FACENAME/CARIT tfMRI IDP (SEPARATE BALSA export)
F_function.features: resting-state + visuomotor amplitudes aggregated to Ji-2019 networks

channels.outcome_blind_rule: No gait/endurance/grip/cognition/diagnosis/medication/outcome variable may enter clock training, model/feature/channel selection, standardization, or covariance estimation.

split.unit: participant id (ALL visits of a participant stay in one partition)
split.hash: sha256(salt + participant_id) -> uniform(0,1); salt frozen in this lock

channel_clocks.model: ElasticNet (primary) via participant-grouped nested CV on development set; ridge fallback
channel_clocks.nonlinear: prespecified SENSITIVITY only (e.g. gradient-boosting), never replaces linear primary

age_bias_correction.formula: g_{im} = alpha_m + beta_m*age_i + eps ; z_{im} = (g_{im} - alpha_m - beta_m*age_i)/s_m
age_bias_correction.s_m: calibration residual scale (std of calibration residuals)

channel_clocks.freeze: ALL clock + bias + scale coefficients frozen before ANY outcome access.

geometry.helmert_properties: C·1 = 0 ; C·C^T = I_3 (rows orthonormal, orthogonal to all-ones)
geometry.q: q_i = C z_i   (3-vector in contrast subspace)
geometry.D: D_brain,i = sqrt(q_i^T Sigma_q^{-1} q_i), Sigma_q = Ledoit-Wolf covariance on CALIBRATION q
geometry.honesty: q lies in contrast subspace orthogonal to all-ones; D is a nonnegative norm of that residual. D is NOT an orthogonal direction and NOT guaranteed independent of A. Adjust for A in all D tests.

availability_gate.evaluated_on: participant-visit manifest, using AVAILABILITY COUNTS ONLY (outcome-blind)
availability_gate.primary_selection_LOCKED: Longitudinal is PRIMARY. Because 20% final-test (<=279) cannot reach the original 300 threshold, the longitudinal test is run on the 40% NON-TRAINING holdout (calibration+final, ~360 complete) — clocks remain frozen on the untouched 60% development set, so no clock leakage. Threshold: >=150 complete longitudinal participants in the holdout. If <150, longitudinal is labeled underpowered and cross-sectional becomes primary.
availability_gate.rationale: Data-adaptive but OUTCOME-BLIND: selection uses only availability counts, decided/hashed before any outcome value is read. Corrects an arithmetic impossibility in the original >=300@20% rule.

primary_test.outcome: annualized change in 4-meter gait speed: (gait_1 - gait_0)/Δt_i, using tlbx_walk_4_rawscore and days_from_V1
primary_test.model: Δgait = b0 + bD*D_brain0 + bA*A_brain0 + bg*gait0 + f(age0) + sex + education + site + height_inches + bmi + eps
primary_test.inference: 1-df nested LRT / partial-F on bD, two-sided alpha=0.05
primary_test.reporting: Report bD effect size + 95% CI whether significant or not.

cross_sectional_primary_or_secondary.role: confirmatory secondary if longitudinal powered; PROMOTED to primary only if longitudinal <150
cross_sectional_primary_or_secondary.model: gait_i = b0 + f(age) + sex + education + site + height_inches + bmi + bA*A_brain + bD*D_brain + eps; compare +A vs +A+D

family: cognition: moca_sum, RAVLT episodic memory, Trails exec/proc-speed
within-person ΔD vs Δgait beyond ΔA
raw functional-reserve score vs fMRI age-gap transform (extends MotionVector boundary result)
within-vector SD and range (does covariance normalization add anything)
secondaries.rule: A favorable secondary NEVER replaces a null primary.

mrs_anchor.role: secondary molecular anchor (NOT omics, NOT causal mediation). Use 'association'/'incremental attenuation'.
gates: build cross-fitted MRS age score ONLY if held-out age r>=0.20
if pass, add MRS z-gap as exploratory 5th channel D5
test prespecified metabolite associations with A_brain, D_brain, gait via FDR

stop_rules: 1. exact chronological age (age_open) and visit interval (days_from_V1) available
2. >=500 complete baseline participants for four-channel analysis
3. >=3 of 4 channel clocks achieve held-out age r>=0.20
4. no visit leakage across participant splits (verified)
5. longitudinal primary requires >=150 complete holdout participants (revised from 300@20%, unreachable)
6. MRS analysis requires >=100 matched QC-passing visits
8. scanner/site and head-motion sensitivity results MANDATORY
9. channels cannot be dropped after seeing gait/cognition
10. if <3 clocks pass, STOP A/D analysis and report technical failure — do not manufacture a vector
novelty_boundary: To our knowledge, first prespecified test of a common calibration-frozen shared-aging vs subsystem-disagreement geometry across cardiac electrical phases, brain imaging processes, and whole-body function, with a longitudinal locomotor endpoint and in-vivo metabolite layer. Do NOT say 'first ever' without qualifier + documented search. A negative result is informative if test + CI reported unchanged.
integrity_notes: Do not claim null tests prove orthogonality, stability, or absence of effect. Do not promote MRS/EEG to rescue a null primary.
